source_title: Jujutsu Kaisen Inspires Edgy Apparel Collection
source_excerpt:

She prefers lore-heavy RPGs and walking sims and has only played Dragon Age: Inquisition 14 times. Her favorite Final Fantasy game is all of them.
Fans of Jujutsu Kaisen can soon pick up some fresh new apparel for winter, as the popular Japanese fashion brand HARE has revealed a packed lineup of dark and edgy goods for fans to enjoy. Since its anime adaptation was released in 2020, Jujutsu Kaisen has continued to grow in popularity globally, with many dubbing it one of the best shonen series of the decade. This has led to a multitude of crossovers and exclusive releases, which will likely not stop any time soon.
Throughout 2026, many popular companies have teamed up with Jujutsu Kaisen to celebrate the anime adaptation's fifth anniversary. The well-known yakiniku chain Gyu-Kaku recently ran a Japan-wide collaboration featuring themed dishes and exclusive merch, while in August, the entire town of Yokohama was decked out in Jujutsu Kaisen swag . Visitors were able to enjoy themed food trucks, take snapshots at special photo spots, play mini-games, and more. The iconic series continues to inspire fresh merchandise as well, as this new lineup has something for men and women alike.
Japanese Fashion Brand HARE Reveals Dark Jujutsu Kaisen Apparel Collection
The Japanese fashion brand HARE has revealed a packed lineup of new apparel inspired by Jujutsu Kaisen, with characters like Yuta, Yuji, Megiumi, and Naoya featured on hoodies, shirts, tote bags, sweaters, and more. Several skirts are also available, with each inspired by Yuta and Naoya's color palettes. Items will be available starting on November 7, 2026 at all HARE locations, as well as online . International shipping is possible through WorldShopping.
Gege Akutami's dark fantasy adventure manga series began in Weekly Shonen Jump in 2018 and quickly became a massive hit with readers. As of this writing, it has sold over 150 million copies , putting it on par with other heavy hitters like Attack on Titan , Bleach , and JoJo's Bizarre Adventure . However, it was its anime adaptation that transformed Jujutsu Kaisen into a truly international phenomenon, with its most recent third season earning largely positive reviews from dedicated fans. The highly anticipated fourth season does not yet have a release date, but it is currently in the works.
Fans of the 2022 roguelike shoot 'em up title Vampire Survivors are in for a treat in 2027, as the upcoming crossover Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton will have the same chaotic and addictive gameplay. Players will be tasked with surviving against Cursed Spirits as they become stronger, fighting to outlast their opponents in an up to 8-player PvP battle royale mode. Over 20 popular Jujutsu Kaisen characters will be included at launch, and the title will be available for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam.

MAPPA, the studio behind Jujutsu Kaisen and other beloved titles such as Chainsaw Man and Attack on Titan , is currently celebrating its 15th anniversary. The MAPPA Expo 15th Anniversary event is currently being held at the Yurakucho Museum in Tokyo until December 7, 2026. Guests can enjoy large-scale installations and video presentations honoring many of the studio's works, along with exclusive merchandise and bonuses.
Jujutsu Kaisen and Jujutsu Kaisen 0 are available to stream on Crunchyroll .
